_l=B62_txt.strip().split("\n");_c=_l[0].split();B62={}
for _r in _l[1:]:
    _p=_r.split()
    for _x,_v in zip(_c,_p[1:]):B62[(_p[0],_x)]=int(_v)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):Ix[i,0]=go+(i-1)*ge;pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):Iy[0,j]=go+(j-1)*ge;pY[0,j]=2
    ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1];row=np.array([B62.get((a,b),-1) for b in s2],float)
        c=np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]]);b=c.argmax(0);M[i,1:]=c[b,ar]+row;pM[i,1:]=b
        c2=np.vstack([M[i-1,1:]+go,Ix[i-1,1:]+ge,Iy[i-1,1:]+go]);b2=c2.argmax(0);Ix[i,1:]=c2[b2,ar];pX[i,1:]=b2
        Mi=M[i];Ixi=Ix[i];Iyi=Iy[i];pYi=pY[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            v0=Mi[j-1]+go;v1=Ixi[j-1]+go;v2=Iyi[j-1]+ge;k=0;v=v0
            if v1>v:v=v1;k=1
            if v2>v:v=v2;k=2
            Iyi[j]=v;pYi[j]=k
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0:A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1:A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1
        else:A.append('-');Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1
        st=int(ns)
        if i==0 and j==0:break
        if i==0:st=2
        elif j==0:st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))
def mapref(ref,q):
    a,b=nw(ref,q);ri=qi=0;mp={}
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!='-':ri+=1
        if y!='-':qi+=1
        if x!='-':mp[ri]=(qi if y!='-' else None,y)
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y and x!='-')
    alnlen=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    return mp,100.0*ident/max(alnlen,1)

ref="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P19120.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
refNBD=ref[:400]
orth=json.load(open("orth.json"))
POS=[(10,"D10","Mg2+/water"),(12,"G12","P-loop"),(13,"T13","beta/gamma-PO4"),(14,"T14","beta/gamma-PO4"),
     (15,"Y15","P-loop"),(37,"T37","P-loop"),(56,"K56","catalysis"),(71,"K71","catalytic Lys"),
     (175,"E175","catalytic base"),(177,"T177","catalysis"),(199,"D199","Mg2+ ligand"),
     (201,"G201","DLGGGT"),(202,"G202","DLGGGT"),(203,"G203","DLGGGT"),(204,"T204","DLGGGT"),
     (206,"D206","Mg2+/K+ ligand"),(230,"G230","adenosine"),(234,"D234","K+ site"),
     (268,"E268","adenosine"),(272,"R272","adenine"),(275,"S275","adenosine"),
     (339,"G339","adenosine"),(342,"R342","adenine"),(366,"D366","P-loop")]
rows=[];idents={}
for name,s in orth.items():
    mp,pid=mapref(refNBD,s[:470]); idents[name]=pid
    rows.append({"species":name, **{lab:mp.get(p,(None,'-'))[1] for p,lab,_ in POS}})
od=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("species"); od.to_csv("hsp110_nematode_ortholog_residues.csv")
v=list(idents.values())
print(f"NBD identity of nematode Hsp110s vs bovine Hsc70 NBD: median {np.median(v):.1f}% range {min(v):.1f}-{max(v):.1f}% (n={len(v)})")
ce=od.loc[[i for i in od.index if "Caenorhabditis elegans" in i][0]]
cons=[]
for p,lab,role in POS:
    col=od[lab];hsc=ref[p-1]
    cons.append({"Hsc70_pos":p,"Hsc70_aa":hsc,"role":role,"Ce_aa":ce[lab],
                 "frac_match_Hsc70":round((col==hsc).mean(),3),
                 "frac_match_Ce":round((col==ce[lab]).mean(),3),
                 "nem_consensus":col.value_counts().index[0],"n":len(col)})
cd=pd.DataFrame(cons); cd.to_csv("hsp110_nbd_residue_conservation.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",220); print(cd.to_string(index=False))

labels=[f"{r.Hsc70_aa}{r.Hsc70_pos}" for r in cd.itertuples()]
x=np.arange(len(cd))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.5),sharex=True,gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1,1.15]})
cols=['#c0392b' if r.role in ('Mg2+/water','beta/gamma-PO4','catalysis','catalytic Lys','catalytic base','Mg2+ ligand','DLGGGT','Mg2+/K+ ligand','K+ site') else '#2a7fb8' for r in cd.itertuples()]
ax[0].bar(x,cd.frac_match_Hsc70*100,color=cols)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% of 49 nematode Hsp110s\ncarrying the Hsp70 residue")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,105);ax[0].axhline(50,ls=':',c='grey',lw=.8)
ax[0].set_title("Hsp70 catalytic and nucleotide-pocket residues mapped onto nematode Hsp110 orthologs\nred = hydrolysis chemistry and Mg2+/K+ coordination, blue = adenosine and phosphate scaffold",fontsize=10)
ax[1].bar(x,cd.frac_match_Ce*100,color='#555555')
ax[1].set_ylabel("% of 49 nematode Hsp110s\nmatching C. elegans HSP-110")
ax[1].set_ylim(0,105)
for i,r in enumerate(cd.itertuples()):
    ax[1].text(i,4,r.Ce_aa,ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=9,color='white',weight='bold')
ax[1].set_xticks(x);ax[1].set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=90,fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel("Position in bovine Hsc70 (UniProt P19120 numbering)")
for a in ax: a.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
